name: hallmark
title_zh: 一眼看出页面像 AI 生成的，并给出改法
tagline_zh: Nutlope 出品的 anti-slop 设计 skill：把「一眼 AI」的页面救回来。
tagline_en: Nutlope's anti-slop design skill — rescues pages from that instant-AI look.
desc_en: Anti-AI-slop design skill for greenfield pages, audits, redesigns, and design extraction from URLs or screenshots. Use when the user asks to build a new app or landing page, wants to redesign something, invokes Hallmark by name, or uses audit/redesign/study.
why_zh: 作者是产出过一堆爆款开源应用的老手，这份审美清单是他 ship 出来的经验，不是理论。
why_en: From a builder with a string of viral open-source apps — shipped taste, not theory.
limit_zh: 只管网页与组件这一层的视觉。防重复靠项目根目录的 .hallmark/log.json，换个项目就从头轮，组件级的活压根不记账。study 读网页走 WebFetch，碰到要登录或纯 JS 的 SPA 只能改让你截图。
limit_en: Scope is web page and component visuals. Anti-repetition memory is .hallmark/log.json at the project root, so a new project restarts the rotation and component runs log nothing. study reads URLs via WebFetch, else asks for a screenshot.
title_en: Spot why a page looks AI-generated, then fix it
